name: inkjet-emu
description: Browser-side virtual PCL3 inkjet printer emulator with GhostPDL rendering.
author: parkertomatoes <parkertomatoes@gmail.com>

scripts.build:ghostpcl-wasm: emcmake cmake -S . -B build/ghostpcl-wasm -U GHOSTPDL_ROOT -U GHOSTPDL_BUILD -U WASM_OPT && cmake --build build/ghostpcl-wasm --target gpcl-stream-dist --parallel
